# Per-Host Capability Registry

One YAML file per machine (`<hostname -s>.yml`), generated by `scripts/env_probe.sh`
(`make env-probe`). Committed to git so every clone knows what every dev host can run.

- **Never edit by hand** — re-run the probe instead.
- `probed_at` + `ttl_days` define freshness; `scripts/env_probe.sh --check`
  (`make env-probe-check`) gates on it. A SessionStart hook runs the check
  automatically in Claude Code sessions.
- Capability facts here are **dated snapshots** (`.agents/rules/environment-truth.md`):
  any mid-session `command not found` / daemon error on a listed capability means
  the entry is stale — re-probe in the same round, regardless of TTL.
- `host_overrides` carry host-conditional execution hints only. The task→command
  SSOT stays in `docs/governance/testing-governance.md §3–§4` — link, don't copy.
- First session on a new machine: run `make env-probe` before relying on any
  recorded environment claim.
